title: Cursor vs Claude Code vs Windsurf: The Developer's Three-Way Guide for 2026
summary: Cursor for daily editing, Claude Code for complex tasks, Windsurf for budget projects. Here's exactly why — with specific use case breakdowns and the power stack most productive developers use in 2026.
body_markdown: Claude Code. For a large codebase migration — TypeScript adoption, framework upgrade, module restructuring — Claude Code's ability to read the entire context, plan autonomously, and execute across many files is unmatched. Cursor's Composer handles multi-file tasks but you supervise each step. Claude Code does the job while you do something else. Use[Blink Cloud](https://blink.new/cloud) with either to handle infrastructure during and after the migration.
